actions: Register a new source/capture manifest with historical independent labels, evidence checksums and domain exclusions
Freeze candidates and protocol before scoring; evaluate once and archive failure as well as success
Collect prospective enrichment with source timestamps and licensed provider access; retrospective values remain diagnostic
Obtain independently supported benign controls; Tranco rank alone does not confirm a benign label

limitations: All observations are retrospective relative to source collection timestamps and are not training features.
The OpenPhish/PhishTank positives and Tranco proxy-benign controls are source-confounded.
Coverage is per provider request/key, not a claim of benign or malicious status.
DNS, RDAP, and InternetDB can change after observation time.

model.threshold_source: frozen from v2 validation; no threshold selection or tuning on PhishVN

inspected_external_url_development_metri.role: Already inspected lightgbm_fresh_v2 development failure, not an untouched evaluation of lightgbm_dev_v2

latency_evidence.limitation: Batch extraction throughput does not establish production request p95 latency

limitations: Previously examined PhishVN/Phish360/visual external sets are development benchmarks
Unknown screenshot domains prevent complete overlap verification; campaigns remain unverified
No training, scoring, model deserialization, threshold selection or activation occurs in this command

domain_bootstrap.delta_definition: mobileclip_v2 minus mobileclip_v1; design weights retained
domain_bootstrap.method: paired campaign_group cluster bootstrap; groups resampled with replacement

limitations: Wilson intervals assume independent observations; residual campaign/domain dependence may remain.
Evidence authenticity requires independent reviewer judgment; checksums cannot establish label truth.
This command neither trains models nor authorizes unsupported scoring paths.

training_exclusions.scope: Frozen candidate-time exclusions; newly registered development datasets cannot retrospectively become its untouched test
